title: Employees and their managers
prompt: Return each employee's name (as employee) along with their manager's name (as manager). Employees with no manager can be excluded, via a self join.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE emp (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, manager_id INTEGER); INSERT INTO emp VALUES (1,'Alice',NULL),(2,'Bob',1),(3,'Carol',1),(4,'Dave',2),(5,'Eve',2);
reference_sql: SELECT e.name AS employee, m.name AS manager FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.manager_id = m.id;
